structure_plan.overview: Simple classic 2x4 brick silhouette (8 studs) built as a 1-brick-tall stack using plates for a quick, interesting mini-build.

subassemblies.name: A: 2x4 Brick Body
subassemblies.description: Three 2x4 plates stacked to reach standard brick height; keep single color (Red suggested).

step_outline.title: Start the brick
step_outline.description: Place 3020 Plate 2 x 4 (Red) as the bottom layer.

step_outline.title: Build up height
step_outline.description: Stack a second 3020 Plate 2 x 4 (Red) aligned exactly on top.

step_outline.title: Finish to brick height
step_outline.description: Stack a third 3020 Plate 2 x 4 (Red) aligned; total height equals 1 standard brick.

notes: Color swap allowed (any available color for 3020), but keep all three layers the same color to match a classic brick.
If you prefer a single-part build, substitute the entire model with 3001 Brick 2 x 4 in the same color (1 piece).
